title: OmniCam: Omni-Camera Trajectory Generation via Geometry-Grounded Pose Token Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.09513v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Camera trajectories control viewpoint changes in video generation, scene reconstruction, and robotic perception. Generating them from language requires both scene geometry and target-aware framing. We introduce OmniCam, an autoregressive model that generates camera pose sequences from a single panorama and textual trajectory descriptions. Its geometry-grounded pose token learning combines three components: a panoramic point-cloud encoder for omnidirectional geometric context; hybrid absolute-rotation and relative-translation tokenization with temporally consistent quaternion signs; and separate geometric and semantic conditioning streams with an explicit 3D target anchor. We also construct OmniCaT, containing 267,700 trajectories across four camera behaviors. On the reported OmniCaT evaluation, OmniCam reduces trajectory errors by 28--47% and collision rate by 65.8% relative to GenDoP retrained on OmniCaT. Against the best base

translated_title: OmniCam：基于几何锚定位姿令牌学习的全向相机轨迹生成
translated_abstract: 相机轨迹控制着视频生成、场景重建和机器人感知中的视角变化。从语言生成相机轨迹既需要理解场景几何，也需要具备目标感知的取景能力。我们提出OmniCam，一个自回归模型，能够从单张全景图和文本轨迹描述生成相机位姿序列。其几何锚定的位姿令牌学习融合了三个组件：用于提供全向几何上下文的全景点云编码器；采用时间一致四元数符号的混合绝对旋转与相对平移标记化方法；以及带有显式3D目标锚点的几何与语义分离条件流。我们还构建了OmniCaT数据集，包含涵盖四种相机行为的267,700条轨迹。在所报告的OmniCaT评估中，相较于在OmniCaT上重新训练的GenDoP，OmniCam将轨迹误差降低了28–47%，碰撞率降低了65.8%。与最佳基线模型相比……
tldr: OmniCam提出几何锚定的位姿令牌学习方法，融合全景点云编码、混合旋转平移标记化和显式3D目标锚点三大组件，实现从单张全景图和文本描述生成高精度、低碰撞率的相机轨迹，误差降低28–47%、碰撞率降低65.8%。
